title: Charts and maps: Tracking oil and US gas prices amid Iran conflict | CNN Business
text:
Source: CNN

Global oil and gas prices are on the rise again after President Donald Trump declared theceasefire agreement with Iran “over.”Previously, oil and gas prices had been declining after the United States and Iran signed apeace plan to end the warin June.

CNN is tracking the price of oil and US gasoline prices, as well astraffic through the Straitof Hormuz, the vital waterway for transporting crude to the rest of the world.

In June, after the peace plan was signed, gasoline prices dropped below the $4 threshold for the first time since March 30, according to theAAA.

See the average price of a gallon of gasoline in each state and how it has changed since the beginning of the US-Israeli war with Iran:

During the war with Iran, gasoline prices were at their highest level in more than three years.

— CNN’s Chris Isidore contributed to this report.
